tasks.brief:
# Game polish discovery (planner-authored 2026-08-09)

## Project
- Linear: Game polish (https://linear.app/ebrierton-cambio/project/game-polish-b61fef31d7b3)
- Repo: https://github.com/evanbrierton/cambio
- Prod: https://cambio.brierton.ie
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + PartyKit (`party/cambio.ts`) + Vitest + Biome

## Already Done (do not reopen)
CAM-74 reconnect drawn-card, CAM-72 Cambio overlay block, CAM-13 snap give-card gate, CAM-12 bots, CAM-6/7 drawn/discard UX, CAM-49 appearance light/dark/system, CAM-76/77 and other earlier polish bugs.

## Open work in this run
### CAM-80 children (ordered)
1. **CAM-82** zustand persist UI prefs — High
2. **CAM-81** cookies-next theme cookie — Medium (blocks 83)
3. **CAM-83** next-themes for 8 style themes — High (after 81)
4. **CAM-84** lucide-react chrome icons — Medium (after 82 clears GameTable hook churn)
5. **CAM-85** zod WS + bot-settings — Medium (after 82 + preferably after 64 message shape)

### Independent polish
- **CAM-64** configurable card points (L) — engine/lobby/themes labels
- **CAM-75** distinct swap VFX/SFX (S) — PixelCard/sounds overlays

### Deferred
CAM-55 `/settings`, CAM-57 theme naming IA, CAM-17 broader SFX/VFX, CAM-56 auth prefs.

## Key paths
### Theme / appearance (CAM-81/83; CAM-49 done)
- `src/context/ThemeProvider.tsx`, `src/lib/theme-cookie.ts`, `src/lib/themes.ts`, `src/lib/theme-fonts.ts`
- `src/app/layout.tsx` SSR seed + FOUC script
- `src/components/ui/ThemePicker.tsx`, `src/hooks/useThemeVoice.ts`, `src/app/globals.css`
- Axes: style=`data-theme` (8 ids); appearance=`cambio-appearance` cookie → `data-appearance`
- Gap: `setThemeCookie`/`setAppearanceCookie` use `cookieStore` and silently no-op when unavailable
- CAM-83 must NOT flatten style+appearance; `enableSystem={false}` on style themes; keep custom appearance path

### Prefs → zustand (CAM-82)
| Pref | Key | Lib | Hook | Consumers |
| Hints | cambio-hints-enabled | src/lib/hints.ts | useHintsEnabled | GameTable |
| Notifs | cambio-chat/event-notifications-enabled | src/lib/notifications.ts | useNotificationPrefs | GameTable |
| Grid/seat | cambio-player-grid-enabled, cambio-own-seat-display | src/lib/player-layout.ts | usePlayerGridEnabled, useOwnSeatDisplay | GameTable |
| Sound | cambio-sound-enabled | accessors in src/lib/sounds.ts | useSoundEnabled | GameTable; playSound reads storage |
| Bots | cambio-bot-settings | src/lib/bot-settings.ts | hydrate in page | src/app/page.tsx |
| Nickname | cambio-player-name | const in src/lib/party.ts | inline in page | src/app/page.tsx |
Keep out: useGameConnection, ephemeral GameTable UI, theme cookies.
Use skipHydration + client rehydrate. zustand already in package.json unused.

### Lucide (CAM-84) — GameTable.tsx
Replace: sheet close `×`, overflow `···`, copy/leave chrome; optional denser toggle icons.
Do NOT lucide: LobbyPlayers empty-seat `···`, suit unicode, flash glyphs ↔/◎/!, brand assets.

### Zod (CAM-85)
Unsafe casts: useGameConnection.ts ServerMessage; party/cambio.ts ClientMessage; bot-settings.ts Partial<BotSettings>.
Unions in src/game/types.ts. zod already in package.json unused.

### Card points (CAM-64)
Hardcoded cardPoints() in src/game/cards.ts. Callers: scoring.ts, bot.ts, bot-chat-events.ts.
Mirror set_joker_count pattern. Add CardPointValues on GameState + lobby selects in LobbyPlayers.tsx + ThemeVoice labels in all 8 themes + README.

### Swap VFX (CAM-75)
Already exists: swap_flash → SwapFlash → SwapFlashOverlay in PixelCard + CSS; dedicated deck/discard draw flashes; swap sound.
Gap: make swap MORE distinct (arc/dual-seat), stop conflating draw/discard/swap audio. Not greenfield.

## Path contention
- GameTable.tsx: CAM-82 then CAM-84 (sequence). CAM-75 must avoid settings chrome.
- themes.ts: CAM-64 voice labels hottest merge risk — CAM-83 should avoid large THEME_VOICES edits.
- theme-cookie + ThemeProvider + layout: CAM-81→83 only.
- types.ts + party/cambio.ts + engine: CAM-64 then CAM-85.
- bot-settings + page: CAM-82 then CAM-85.
- sounds/PixelCard/globals: CAM-75 (CAM-82 only splits sound pref out of sounds.ts).

## Branch / PR conventions
- Push orchestrate task branch exactly as prompted (`orch/game-polish/<task>`).
- openPR workers: draft PR base `main`.
- Linear: In Progress when coding starts; In Review when draft PR open; mention CAM-n in PR title.
- Quality: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test before handoff. No narrative comments.
acceptance: docs/orchestrate/game-polish-discovery.md exists and covers CAM-80 children, CAM-64, CAM-75, path contention, and sequencing
Handoff What I did section includes or links the brief content for dependsOn consumers
No product code changes

tasks.scopedGoal:

6. Five lobby selects in LobbyPlayers.tsx (host editable)
7. ThemeVoice labels for all 8 themes in themes.ts + README scoring docs

Values frozen once play starts. Numbers 2–10 stay face value.

Mark CAM-64 In Progress → In Review. Draft PR. Avoid GameTable settings chrome edits.
